columns.name: noc_queue
columns.reason: The NOC queue a ticket lands in is set when the outage ticket is opened, at the prediction point.

columns.name: antenna_vendor
columns.reason: Static site equipment attribute known long before any outage.

columns.name: band_plan
columns.reason: Static RF configuration of the site.

columns.name: truck_rolls_dispatched
columns.reason: Dispatch count accrues during the response and is only final once the outage ends.

columns.name: postevent_alarm_count
columns.reason: Explicitly counted after the event, so it does not exist at prediction time.

columns.name: shelter_model
columns.reason: Static site infrastructure attribute.

columns.name: rectifier_model
columns.reason: Static power equipment attribute recorded in the asset register.

columns.name: restoration_minutes
columns.reason: It is the outage duration the target is thresholded from, so it both postdates and defines the label.

columns.name: sla_credit_usd
columns.reason: Credit is computed from the realised outage duration after restoration.

columns.name: district_code
columns.reason: Static geographic identifier of the site.

columns.name: feeder_reliability
columns.reason: Historical reliability rating of the serving utility feeder, known in advance.

columns.name: permit_zone
columns.reason: Static regulatory zone assigned to the site.

columns.name: access_road_class
columns.reason: Static site access characteristic.

columns.name: site_elevation_m
columns.reason: Fixed physical property of the site.

columns.name: battery_age_months
columns.reason: Battery age is known from install records at the moment the outage starts.

columns.name: lightning_density
columns.reason: Climatological rate for the site's area, established before the event.

columns.name: backhaul_vendor
columns.reason: Static contracted transport provider for the site.

columns.name: region_group
columns.reason: Static organisational geography label.

columns.name: security_tier
columns.reason: Pre-assigned site security classification.

columns.name: landlord_type
columns.reason: Static lease/ownership attribute of the site.

columns.name: sector_count
columns.reason: Static configuration count of sectors on the tower.

columns.name: zoning_class
columns.reason: Static municipal zoning designation.

columns.name: fuel_contract
columns.reason: Standing refuelling contract for the site, in place before the outage.

columns.name: escalation_tier
columns.reason: Incident escalation level is typically raised as the outage drags on, so it is not final at prediction time.

columns.name: guy_wire_flag
columns.reason: Static structural property of the tower.

columns.name: spares_depot
columns.reason: Standing assignment of the depot serving the site.

columns.name: grounding_spec
columns.reason: Static engineering specification recorded for the site.

columns.name: tower_height_band
columns.reason: Fixed physical attribute of the structure.

columns.name: climb_permit_class
columns.reason: Standing permit classification governing climbs at the site.

columns.name: tower_class
columns.reason: Static structural classification of the tower.

columns.name: power_utility
columns.reason: Static identity of the serving electric utility.

columns.name: hvac_model
columns.reason: Static installed cooling equipment attribute.

columns.name: crew_base
columns.reason: Standing home base assigned to the field crew covering the site.

columns.name: generator_runtime_index
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether this is a standing generator capability/wear index or runtime accumulated during this outage.

columns.name: market_code
columns.reason: Static market identifier for the site.

columns.name: lease_expiry_band
columns.reason: Derived from the existing lease term, known before the outage.

columns.name: fence_type
columns.reason: Static site compound attribute.

columns.name: cabinet_model
columns.reason: Static installed equipment attribute.
